name: @bertonha/getthingsdone-desktop
description: Get Things Done desktop app (Electron shell around the same server and dashboard)

scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --dir --publish never -c.mac.identity=-
scripts.dist:unsigned: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --publish never -c.mac.identity=-

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Get Things Done records the meetings you choose to record, and saves them in your workspace.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Get Things Done records the sound of a meeting you choose to record, such as the other people in a call, and saves it in your workspace.

author: Geovanne Bertonha
